CompanyProfile.ShortDescription: Legal technology and enterprise legal services provider focused on eDiscovery, document review, investigations, and related legal solutions.
CompanyProfile.OverviewText: Consilio states that it provides end-to-end eDiscovery, legal technology solutions, document review, investigations, legal talent and enterprise legal services. Founded in 2000 as First Advantage Litigation Consulting and renamed Consilio in 2013. The supplied profile identifies Washington, DC as headquarters. Current ownership and legal registration details remain to be confirmed.
